name: Registered Contract 17
definition: Document that a user must file with an authorised servicer for each contract that involves foreign currency transactions with non residents.

RegisteredContractAmendmentIdentificatio.name: Registered Contract Amendment Identification
RegisteredContractAmendmentIdentificatio.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the registered contract amendment request.

OriginalRegisteredContractIdentification.name: Original Registered Contract Identification
OriginalRegisteredContractIdentification.definition: Identification of the original contract registration, as registered with the registration agent.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Priority requested for the amendment of the registered contract.

Contract.name: Contract
Contract.definition: Amendment details of the registered contract for the registered contract.

ContractBalance.name: Contract Balance
ContractBalance.definition: Contract balance on date of contract registration.

PaymentScheduleType.name: Payment Schedule Type
PaymentScheduleType.definition: Type of the payment schedule provided in the contract.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further additional information on the amendment.

Attachment.name: Attachment
Attachment.definition: Documents provided as attachments to the contract registration amendment request.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
